newsitem.title: UK: ARA BUNKER PRICES FIRM, OTHER REGIONS FLAT.
newsitem.headline: ARA BUNKER PRICES FIRM, OTHER REGIONS FLAT.

text.p: Bunker fuel prices in the ARA region were around a dollar firmer on Tuesday but prices in most other sectors were fairly flat, traders said.
Fob prices in Rotterdam for 380 cst material were around $98 a tonne, around a dollar up from Monday, while 180 cst barrels were talked closer to $101.
"There is not an enormous amount around," one dealer said.

Algeciras ex-wharf prices were flat to slightly weaker at $100 or $101 with 180 cst numbers about six dollars higher. Diesel bunkers were talked a little weaker at around $191 in Algeciras while gas oil was talked at $194/$197.
